profile.headline: Web Developer, Efficiency Enthusiast
profile.summary: Using the troubleshooting skills developed in my Digital Media Art undergrad studies, I pivoted my career from an art to a technology focus. I now diagnose and remedy the programming errors I once reported as a Customer Service Agent.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
•  Developed and implemented Salesforce, and Braze integrations to automatically generate mailpieces cutting implementation time from months to minutes
•  Reduced endpoint response time by up to 80% through efficient caching strategies, significantly improving performance.
•  Secured 200k deal by demoing and implementing adjustments to integrations
•  Overhauled flaky initialization process into a robust asynchronous process, eliminating the need for manual retries
•  Worked on Lob’s Growth and Core Experience teams to design, build, and ship features for customer• facing Vue 3 dashboard, core Node.js APIs to create mail pieces, and flagship Automated Campaigns product.

positions.title: Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
•  Enabled over 1000 new users with solo- developed Figma Plugin built with React and Typescript
•  Architected and implemented highly- demanded SFTP to mail process with AWS DDB, API Gateway, Lambda and S3, thus securing multiple contracts
•  Consistently a top performer in both securing and retaining contracts
•  Recognized by direct supervisor for “setting a new standard for Solutions Engineering"

positions.title: Junior Internal Tools Developer
positions.description:
•  Maintained and developed Java Spring Boot REST API
•  Designed and implemented front end applications using JQuery / React
•  Lead initiative and sole developer of automated on• call alert escalation, saving company two• hundred thousand dollars annually
•  Created custom monitoring metrics for Prometheus using containerized Golang applications

positions.title: Site Reliability Technician
positions.description:
•  Helped maintain the site reliability of all corporate properties
•  Monitored server health using third• party software
•  Performed first level remediation of server reliability issues
•  Escalated issues after diagnosis and/or first remediation
•  Physically racked and cabled servers and network switches
•  Installed, tested, and troubleshot new server hardware components
•  Upgraded server component firmware
•  Responded to issues relayed by other departments

positions.title: Tier 2 Tech Support
positions.description:
•  Responded to service tickets and requests for local desktop support for assigned offices and remote desktop support for other offices as required to meet service level agreements.
•  Troubleshot and resolve hardware, software, application, network, user access, or related issues 
•  Escalated more complex problems or unresolved issues to next level of support. 
•  Interacted with network services, software systems engineering, and/or applications development to restore service and/or identify and correct core problem. 
•  Held accountable for the successful resolution of all customer requests.

positions.title: Visual Effects Intern
positions.description:
Produced exceptional work for assigned projects in animation and vfx
Designed key art and, whenever necessary, produced assets needed for projects
Communicated with video production staff to fulfill graphics requests

positions.title: Audio Visual Technician
positions.description:
Set up and install audio and video equipment
Compress and digitize audio and video data
Set up and operate LED fascia systems
Ensure seamless transitions between media
Coordinate with other staff to ensure successful presentations

positions.title: Counselor and Instructor
positions.description: Created and provided an award-winning curriculum in the areas of digital art and animation for children ages 11 to 13.

honors.title: Dean's Scholar List
honors.description: Dean's honor for exceptional grade point average across several years.
